title: Practice: Past perfect: I had written

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **стать → стал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
**начать → начали** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.
exercises.prompt: The listeners had already begun to yawn.
Saddam Hussein had disappeared into hiding.
A baby rabbit had been caught in a trap.

exercises.q: Цен на сельхозпродукцию ___ (упасть) на пятьдесят пять процентов.
exercises.prompt: Farm prices had fallen fifty-five percent.

exercises.why: **потерять → потерял** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
exercises.prompt: His mind had lost its sharpness.

exercises.why: **назвать → назвал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.
exercises.prompt: He had called the rebels traitors.

exercises.why: **собраться → Собралась** — past tense, fem.: drop -ться, add -лась.
exercises.prompt: A crowd of onlookers had gathered.

exercises.why: **начаться → началась** — past tense, fem.: drop -ться, add -лась.
exercises.prompt: The French and Indian War had begun.
The runner had reached the halfway mark.
